verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents reserved instances that let users pre-pay for GPU time to lock in up to 50% discounts, and any on-demand instance can be converted to reserved at any time, directly matching the committed-use discount story. missing for 10: no evidence of longer-term (monthly/annual) committed contracts beyond simple pre-payment conversion, no independent/community corroboration of actual reserved-instance savings or reliability, and no detail on capacity guarantees tied to the discount.
